title: Bigville adapter navigation retrieval probes
provenance: Six frozen tasks selected from distinct Bigville scenario, seed-dependency, generated-seed, pack, and route examples. Expected paths are the source records at the ends of the requested navigation; representative graph relationships are independently asserted by navigation_eval.py.

tasks.task: For the house argument scenario, locate its conversation knowledge definition and determine which source copy the runtime reference can mean.
tasks.notes: Exercises scenario-to-seed navigation and path-distinct duplicate ID handling.

tasks.task: Trace the generated council charter knowledge back to the authored pack table and identify the declared source provenance.
tasks.notes: Exercises generated seed to pack table provenance navigation.

tasks.task: Find the authored terrain movement rules table that produced the packaged terrain movement knowledge, including its pack declaration.
tasks.notes: Second generated seed/table example from a different pack domain.

tasks.task: The packaged bell schedule declares a dependency on shared bell knowledge. Find every available manifest for that dependency and determine whether the ID selects one copy.
tasks.notes: Exercises a manifest dependency edge with duplicate path-distinct target IDs.

tasks.task: For the four player Monopoly scenario, find both conversation manifests and both conversation reply manifests that its ID-only seed references can resolve to.
tasks.notes: Second scenario exercises ambiguity across two seed IDs rather than one reference.

tasks.task: Trace the management browser's backend profile listing request to the server handler that implements the same HTTP endpoint.
tasks.notes: Exercises explicit browser request to server route joining.
